description: Ministry of Plantations - Amended the Sri Lanka Tea Board (Registration of Tea Packers) Regulations
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to regulations under the Sri Lanka Tea Board Law, specifically modifying registration and renewal fees for tea packers and updating definitions. It involves legal/regulatory changes to existing statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it modifies subsidiary legislation rather than addressing government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
